keyPoints.en: Generators use electromagnetic induction; turbines are turned by steam, water or wind.
keyPoints.bm: Penjana menggunakan aruhan elektromagnet; turbin diputar oleh stim, air atau angin.

keyPoints.en: Sources: renewable (solar, hydro, wind, biomass) and non-renewable (coal, gas, oil, nuclear fuel).
keyPoints.bm: Sumber: boleh diperbaharui (suria, hidro, angin, biojisim) dan tidak boleh diperbaharui (arang batu, gas, minyak, bahan api nuklear).

keyPoints.en: Transformer: primary coil, secondary coil, soft-iron core; works with a.c. only.
keyPoints.bm: Transformer: gegelung primer, gegelung sekunder, teras besi lembut; berfungsi dengan a.u. sahaja.

keyPoints.en: Vs/Vp = Ns/Np. Step-up: Ns > Np. Step-down: Ns < Np.
keyPoints.bm: Vs/Vp = Ns/Np. Injak naik: Ns > Np. Injak turun: Ns < Np.

keyPoints.en: Transmit at high voltage (lower current) to reduce heat loss; step down at substations.
keyPoints.bm: Hantar pada voltan tinggi (arus lebih rendah) untuk mengurangkan kehilangan haba; turunkan di pencawang.

keyPoints.en: Homes get 240 V. Wires: live (brown), neutral (blue), earth (green-yellow).
keyPoints.bm: Rumah menerima 240 V. Wayar: hidup (perang), neutral (biru), bumi (hijau-kuning).

keyPoints.en: Safety: fuse, MCB, earth wire, residual-current device; never overload sockets.
keyPoints.bm: Keselamatan: fius, MCB, wayar bumi, peranti arus baki; jangan bebankan soket.

keyPoints.en: P = VI; choose a fuse rated just above the normal current.
keyPoints.bm: P = VI; pilih fius berkadar sedikit melebihi arus biasa.

keyPoints.en: E = Pt; with P in kW and t in hours, E is in kWh.
keyPoints.bm: E = Pt; dengan P dalam kW dan t dalam jam, E dalam kWj.

keyPoints.en: Cost = kWh × rate. Save energy: switch off, use efficient appliances.
keyPoints.bm: Kos = kWj × kadar. Jimat tenaga: tutup suis, guna perkakas cekap.

tip.en: Convert W to kW (÷ 1000) and minutes to hours (÷ 60) before calculating kWh.
tip.bm: Tukar W kepada kW (÷ 1000) dan minit kepada jam (÷ 60) sebelum mengira kWj.
